sloka: नाहत्वा समरे शत्रुं विष्णुः प्रतिनिवर्तते ।दुर्लभश्चैव कामो ऽद्य वरगुप्ताद्धि रावणात् ।। ७.२७.१८ ॥
transliteration: nāhatvā samare śatruṁ viṣṇuḥ pratinivartate ।durlabhaścaiva kāmo 'dya varaguptāddhi rāvaṇāt ।। 7.27.18 ॥

translations.english: Vishnu does not return from battle without killing the enemy, and indeed, it is difficult to fulfill this desire now because Ravana is protected by boons.
translations.hindi: यह्‌ महाकान्तिमान्‌ शीघ्रगामी सवारी पर सवार हो, जा रहा है । पर्वत के इस बचन को सुन रावण ने कहा
